lab_tests.name: Blood Sugar – Fasting & Post-prandial
lab_tests.prep: Fast 10–12 hours; second sample 2 hours after food

lab_tests.name: Pap Smear
lab_tests.prep: Avoid during periods; no douching 48 hours before

lab_tests.name: Biopsy (Histopathology)
lab_tests.prep: Bring the referral and sample container from the doctor

lab_tests.name: RT-PCR (Respiratory panel)
lab_tests.prep: No food or drink 30 minutes before

lab_tests.name: Ultrasound Abdomen & Pelvis
lab_tests.prep: Fast 6 hours; full bladder (drink 1 litre water 1 hour before)

lab_tests.name: MRI Lumbar Spine
lab_tests.prep: Remove all metal; tell us about implants or pacemaker

lab_tests.name: Mammography (both breasts)
lab_tests.prep: No deodorant or powder on the day

lab_tests.name: Treadmill Test (TMT)
lab_tests.prep: Light meal 2 hours before; wear walking shoes

lab_tests.name: Pulmonary Function Test
lab_tests.prep: No inhalers 4 hours before (ask your doctor)
